mapper.select: select bm_lot_release_template.id, bm_lot_release_template.name, bm_lot_release_template.effective_lot_release_id, bm_lot_release.no, bm_lot_release.template_version, bm_lot_release.generator_name, bm_lot_release.generator_id, bm_lot_release.generate_time, bm_lot_release.effect_time, bm_lot_release.file_url from bm_lot_release_template_process left join bm_lot_release_template on bm_lot_release_template.id = bm_lot_release_template_process.lot_release_template_id and bm_lot_release_template.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_lot_release on bm_lot_release_template.effective_lot_release_id = bm_lot_release.id and bm_lot_release.plan_id = #{planId} and bm_lot_release.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_product_plan on bm_product_plan.id = bm_lot_release.plan_id and bm_product_plan.is_deleted = 0 where bm_lot_release_template_process.process_id = #{processId}

select bm_lot_release.id, bm_lot_release.plan_id, bm_lot_release.product_name, bm_lot_release.process_name, bm_product_plan.process_version, bm_lot_release.batch_no, bm_product_plan.start_time from bm_lot_release left join bm_product_plan on bm_lot_release.plan_id = bm_product_plan.id and bm_product_plan.is_deleted = 0 where bm_lot_release.is_deleted = 0 and bm_lot_release.process_id = #{processId}
